fullPassage: The ambulance has given life to many dying patients with its quick service. Its story goes back to 1792 when Napoleon's personal physician Baron Dominique Jean Larrey had the brilliant idea that wounded soldiers should be taken out of the battlefield on a horse carriage. Before then, there was no provision to carry them out and wounded soldiers were usually left to their fate. Dr. Dominique, together with the chief surgeon of the French army, Dr. Pierre-François Percy, established the Ambulance Corps. Each division had 12 such ambulances. This corps was used in the 1796 war between France and Italy. It was a great success. Many countries followed suit and built their own fleet of ambulances. In 1864, the ambulance was officially accepted in the International Geneva Agreement and it was decided that no one would attack an ambulance during war.

questions.passage: The ambulance has given life to many dying patients with its quick service. Its story goes back to 1792 when Napoleon's personal physician Baron Dominique Jean Larrey had the brilliant idea that wounded soldiers should be taken out of the battlefield on a horse carriage. Before then, there was no provision to carry them out and wounded soldiers were usually left to their fate. Dr. Dominique, together with the chief surgeon of the French army, Dr. Pierre-François Percy, established the Ambulance Corps. Each division had 12 such ambulances. This corps was used in the 1796 war between France and Italy. It was a great success. Many countries followed suit and built their own fleet of ambulances. In 1864, the ambulance was officially accepted in the International Geneva Agreement and it was decided that no one would attack an ambulance during war.

det.korean: left to their(운명에 맡겨진) — S3에서 부상 병사들이 후송 수단 없이 '운명에 맡겨졌다'는 표현.
det.analysis:
S3: wounded soldiers were usually left to their fate → 부상 병사의 상황: left to their (3단어)
3단어 확인: left(1) to(2) their(3) ✅
det.tip: S3: left to their fate — 운명에 내맡겨지다

questions.stem: 다음 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

ch: 전쟁 중 부상병을 치료하는 것은 현실적으로 불가능하다.
